execution_request_english: Perform one bounded TMM thickness optimization for an exactly 20-layer planar stack. Use the fixed material sequence from the incident side: HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica / HfO2 / Fused Silica. Optimize only the physical thickness of each finite layer within the user-declared bounds. Do not optimize material identity or layer count in this route. Optimize a 20-layer HfO2/SiO2 alternating stack on fused silica substrate at normal incidence. Initialize thicknesses from the following baseline profile (in nm, starting from air side): [53.0, 272.0, 81.0, 83.0, 55.0, 94.0, 94.0, 91.0, 245.0, 92.0, 68.0, 196.0, 54.0, 84.0, 77.0, 211.0, 162.0, 74.0, 135.0, 86.0]. Apply Gaussian perturbation with standard deviation σ = 8 nm for population reinitialization. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with step-size multiplier reduced by 50% relative to default to prioritize local exploitation. Evaluate at wavelengths 1530-1565 nm (transmittance objective) and 400-700 nm (reflectance objective). Total layer count fixed at 20. Material sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2... (odd layers HfO2, even layers SiO2). Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 6 alternating HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 30.
revision_reason: Per feedback directives: reinitialize evolutionary population from Candidate 0's Round 1 thickness profile using narrow Gaussian (σ = 8 nm) and reduce optimizer step-size multiplier by 50% to prioritize local exploitation over global exploration, capitalizing on the verified feasible region.
